q.line: Show me all your figure paintings
stanza: There is no use in waiting
Offer up your steps so I can climb
Show me all your figure paintings
Etched in the middle of the night
Let me stretch upon your carpet
Let me hear the rain tap on your street
Knowing I am safe on the inside
Blankets wrapped and drifting off to sleep

partner.line: There is no use in waiting

q.line: All the rowboats in the paintings
stanza: All the rowboats in the paintings
They keep trying to row away
Stay contorted and staring at the waves

partner.line: They keep trying to row away

q.line: All the rowboats in oil paintings
stanza: They'll keep hanging in their gold frames
For forever, forever and a day
All the rowboats in oil paintings
They keep trying to row away, row away

partner.line: For forever, forever and a day
